description: This source file defines the 'DbSessionFactory' class, which acts as a wrapper or utility around Hibernate's 'SessionFactory' within the OpenMRS project. It is used to support multiple versions of OpenMRS, providing access to Hibernate sessions.

classes.description: A utility class for managing Hibernate sessions in the OpenMRS framework, supporting multiple OpenMRS versions.
